audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer sides read 'Skill' while content win[] and the packet both say Lissandra levels 1 through 6, Sylas from first item on. Full whys for rows 1-5 also described Sylas winning.
audit.why: Lissandra's Q range, held W root and E escape deny Sylas's whole engage pattern until his item + Hijack of her R swings it.
audit.corrected: Full sides moved to Lissandra (rows 1-5) and Sylas (first item, 2+ items); whys for the Lissandra rows rewritten to the correct verdict.

audit.why: Spikes: Lissandra controls 1-5 and survives the first 6 all-in with R self-stasis; Sylas swings it at first item + Hijack and outscales. Content spikes[] covers all four.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; 'Ice Shards' should be Ice Shard (packet suspectNames); 18 misgendered fields; two copy-paste-bleed bullets.
audit.why: Glacial Path is 24s at rank 1, Ring of Frost 10s, Frozen Tomb 120s and heals her during the self-stasis; her W root shuts off Abscond and her R stasis eats the first Abduct all-in.
audit.corrected: Numbers added, ability name fixed, pronouns fixed, bleed bodies rewritten around the R steal and the R timer.

notes: Chart: content win[] and packet agree (Lissandra rows 1-6, Sylas from first item); full sides moved to match — win[] already correct, so side-only per the chart rule, with whys rewritten for every row whose verdict is Lissandra. Packet defect claims the chart contradicts the 52.65% Sylas win rate; the kits support Lissandra's lane control with a Sylas item/steal swing, and both data layers agree, so the chart was kept as-is — flagging for the user rather than inventing a different split. Missing-interaction (Grievous Wounds vs Frozen Tomb's self-stasis heal) could not be added: report[8].t has no room inside the length band; the heal only happens on a defensive self-cast, so low priority — noted here. 'Ice Shards' corrected to Ice Shard per packet suspectNames.
